quandoUsar: Notification inbox behind a bell in an app header, with read and unread state and a count on the badge.
When the person needs to triage: open a notification's detail, mark it as read, dismiss it, mark all as read, or clear the read ones.
quandoEvitar: Use `toast` or `toast-stack` for the immediate feedback of an action the person just took.
Use `notification-stack` when notifications stay visible on the page as a stack of cards dismissed one by one, with no read state.
Use `timeline` for a full-page activity history, grouped by day.

teclado.acao: On the bell, open or close the panel; on a row, show or hide the detail with its actions.
Closes the panel and returns focus to the bell.
Move through the panel's controls: close, the “All” and “Unread” filters, rows, and actions.

acessibilidade: It is a Radix popover: the bell receives `aria-expanded` from the primitive and an `aria-label` with `label` plus the unread count; the panel carries an `aria-label` and the summary is `aria-live="polite"`.
Each row is a button with `aria-expanded` and a name that combines the title, the unread state, and the show-or-hide-details action; the filters use `aria-pressed`.
Focus is repositioned after each action: on dismiss it goes to the neighboring row, and after bulk actions it goes to the filter buttons.
movimento: The panel grows from the bell, which tilts 12° while open; rows enter in a 35 ms cascade and collapse their own height on a spring when leaving, in sequence on bulk actions.

The counts roll like an odometer (the larger number rises from below, the smaller one descends from above), the filter highlight slides between “All” and “Unread”, and the mark-as-read button animates its width when its label changes.
With “reduce motion” on, the CSS animations are removed and changes become a short fade or happen instantly.
responsivo: The panel has width `min(424px, 100vw - 24px)` and maximum height `min(590px, 100vh - 24px)`; the list scrolls inside, with the scrollbar hidden.
Up to 380 px of viewport the spacing shrinks and “Mark all read” loses its text, leaving only the icon.
desempenho: All notifications are rendered at once, each row with a height animation and no virtualization; keep the list in the tens.
notasIA: `notifications` is only the initial state (it goes into a `useState`): later changes to the prop are ignored, so to inject new notifications remount with a different `key`.
Persist with `onReadChange(notification, read)` and `onDismiss(notification)`, called once per item also on bulk actions; `time` is ready-made text, the component does not format dates.
Import from `@/components/ryan-ui/notification-center/notification-center` (it does not live in `blocks/`); it already draws the bell, depends on `avatar`, and accepts `open` with `onOpenChange`.
